detail.longDescription: When you read the word "apple," what image pops into your head? For me, it's usually a blurry outline of an apple, or (if I'm reading fast) just a loose connection to what the word means. Imagine my jealousy when I discovered that I fall on the aphantasia spectrum, and some people's brains automatically translate text into vivid, realistic images.
